commits.author: Michael Coulter
commits.subject: BRUNEL-3314: Present diffs on logical canvas
commits.message:
BRUNEL-3314: Present diffs on logical canvas

- add side‑by‑side diff experience (CanvasDiffComponent, pane, routing/module wiring) with layout toggle, visible-network filter, diff summary & fullscreen controls
- bridge menu-->Angular-->Electron workflow for diff runs (View ▸ “Logical Canvas Diff…”, CanvasDiffService, DataService shell helpers, Electron IPC wiring, brunel/test.py logging)
- implement Python diff engine resources/scripts/canvas/canvas_diff.py emitting two view models + structured instance/interface/connection deltas, writing diagnostics to canvas_diff_py.log
- extend logical services to support diff contexts: inject diff payloads, hold per-node status/details, expose helpers to canvases, ensure read-only panes subscribe independently
- adapt canvas-floorplan-logical.component for diff overlays (standalone Pixi app per pane, fixed overlay size, colored tooltips, read-only cursor handling) and respect network filters via nodesContainer
- update shared services (instances/interfaces/connections/gui-data) to accept diff inputs, fetch instance attributes for both panes, and stringify debug output
- document new workflow (manual overrides), surface logs (menu-bar/main.js), and keep test harness consistent with diff execution

Change-Id: Ia9889878b163445d7f88e77161eea7306fad90aa

commits.author: Michael Coulter
commits.subject: This change introduces and integrates a comprehensive orchestration framework under
commits.message:
This change introduces and integrates a comprehensive orchestration framework under
`GUI/agent` and expands the automated documentation system for the GUI
source tree. Together, these updates provide a structured foundation for
planning, analysis, documentation enforcement, and curated narratives.

Highlights:

• **Initial Documentation Generation**
  - Generated markdown docs for all 174 directories under `GUI/src/app`,
    including refreshed `app.md`. Each doc now carries an overview,
    directory map with relative links, and per-file sections. Specs are
    listed but marked as “analysis skipped” while still showing
    dependencies. Unresolved imports are flagged for follow-up.

• **Tooling & Scripts**
  - Moved doc tools into `GUI/agent` for reproducibility.
  - Added `npm run ai-gui-docgen` for one-step regeneration of docs.
  - Updated `collect-app-docs-data.js` to classify decorated classes
    (`@Component`, `@Injectable`, `@NgModule`, etc.) with explicit type
    flags.
  - Enhanced `render-app-docs.py` to preserve richer class metadata,
    cache summaries, and prepend plain-English folder overviews.

• **Curated Narratives & Overrides**
  - Introduced manual override files (`agent/manual-overrides/*`) to
    inject curated narratives into generated docs, starting with Canvas,
    Interfaces, Device Groups, and shared UI primitives.
  - Regenerated all feature docs so curated context is merged seamlessly
    into auto-generated content.

• **Pipeline Improvements**
  - Documentation now tracks its source commit via
    `agent/latest-md-hash.txt` for incremental refreshes.
  - `agent/README.md` updated with workflows for overrides, regeneration,
    and prompts for refresh.

• **Agent Orchestration Layer**
  - Added config, policies, standardized system/sub-agent prompts
    (`code_breaker`, `doc_guard`).
  - Implemented runtime modules: bootloader, context index, action
    planner, and analysis helpers.
  - Code-Breaker agent identifies TODO/test coverage gaps and proposes
    fixes; Doc-Guard enforces doc drift checks.
  - CI guard (`agent_doc_drift_check.py`, shell wrapper, and GitHub
    Actions workflow) blocks merges when docs fall out of sync.
  - Operator guide and CLI utilities (`agent_build_index.py`) provide
    reproducible workflows.

• **Extended Planning Context**
  - Surfaced front/back plumbing, tab bar information, UI frameset ideas,
    and lifecycle flow into the planning context.

**Impact**
- Documentation is now structured, searchable, and automatically
  regenerable with curated feature narratives.
- Contributors can regenerate, validate, and enforce docs in one step or
  via CI.
- The orchestration layer establishes a durable foundation for consistent
  planning, enforcement, and guided workflows.
